company_description: Fortis Inc. is a Canadian utility group specializing in the generation, transmission, and distribution of electricity and natural gas, with operations primarily in North America. The company serves over 3.6 million customers through its regulated subsidiaries.

kpis.name: Operating Revenue
kpis.explanation: Total revenues generated from the company's regulated and non-regulated activities.

kpis.name: Adjusted EPS
kpis.explanation: Earnings per share excluding exceptional items, a key performance measure for investors.

kpis.name: Planned Capital Expenditures
kpis.explanation: Amount invested in infrastructure to maintain and expand networks.

kpis.name: Net Debt to EBITDA Ratio
kpis.explanation: Financial health indicator measuring the ability to repay debt.

kpis.name: Annual Dividend per Share
kpis.explanation: Regular distribution to shareholders, indexed to adjusted EPS growth.

kpis.name: Total Number of Customers
kpis.explanation: Indicator of size and reach of distribution operations.

kpis.name: Annual Dividend Growth Rate
kpis.explanation: Average annual dividend growth over 20 years, evidence of stability.

kpis.name: Return on Regulated Assets
kpis.explanation: Profitability of assets subject to rate regulation.

kpis.name: Accelerated Investments in Resilient Networks
kpis.description: Fortis is increasing investments to modernize its networks in response to climate challenges, supporting sustainable organic growth.

kpis.name: Successful Integration of Seminole
kpis.description: The acquisition of Seminole in Florida strengthens the U.S. presence and adds high-return assets.

kpis.name: Carbon Emissions Reduction
kpis.description: 45% reduction in emissions since 2015, aligned with net zero targets by 2050.

kpis.name: Customer Systems Modernization
kpis.description: 80% of customer interactions now digital, improving operational efficiency.

kpis.name: Higher Approved Return Rates
kpis.description: Secured higher return rates in multiple jurisdictions, supporting future profitability.

risks.description: Dependence on rate-setting decisions by regulatory bodies, with potentially long adjustment timelines.
risks.score_rationale: Central position in the 10-K, cautious language on regulatory timelines, upward trend in costs, high weight of regulated assets.

risks.description: Interest rate sensitivity due to significant long-term debt and required new financing.
risks.score_rationale: Repeatedly mentioned in the MD&A section, increased intensity in 2024, rising debt costs, direct impact on margins.

risks.description: Increased climate risk for electrical infrastructure in exposed regions (e.g., Florida, British Columbia).
risks.score_rationale: Present in the ESG report, moderate language, increasing trend in extreme events, growing geographic exposure.

ai_positioning.summary: Progressive and cautious approach to artificial intelligence, focused on operational efficiency.
evidence: Limited use of AI in network predictive maintenance.
Ongoing pilots for customer service automation.
No declared AI strategy in strategic documents.
